identity.title: Distinguish Preview processing success from inspection acceptance

origin.kind: scheduled 2D task execution and source review
origin.summary: The 2D plan identifies that Preview OK currently describes tool execution/result-image success but can be read as a Pipeline Acceptance pass. The bounded change must make the distinction explicit in existing status, review, and exported evidence surfaces.

state.current_summary: The owner-local change now distinguishes direct Preview processing from inspection judgment, carries acceptance configuration into persisted Run Report/evidence, and verifies the distinction with Korean/English contracts and final Debug/Release builds. A final native Preview rerun opened the WPF shell but timed out without a report; the prior native Preview pass and the final Pipeline Review acceptance-NG UI smoke are retained as separate evidence, while full theme/DPI/native hardware coverage remains unverified.

claims.text: Direct native Preview success is published as Preview OK without stating that Pipeline Acceptance is not evaluated, while Pipeline Review summaries expose only the aggregate OK/NG status unless the detail happens to include an acceptance failure message.

problem.impact: A first-time contributor or operator can interpret a successful tool execution and result image as an inspection PASS, and exported evidence cannot unambiguously show whether acceptance criteria were applied.

criteria.text: Native Preview status retains the existing Preview OK/Preview NG or Offset OK parser prefix and explicitly states that inspection judgment is not evaluated for direct tool Preview; no acceptance evaluator is added to that path.

Pipeline Review result text distinguishes tool processing and acceptance for no-criteria success, acceptance PASS, acceptance NG, and tool failure, while preserving existing OK/NG status tokens and run-log contracts.

Persisted Run Report and recipe evidence preserve whether acceptance was configured/evaluated; no-criteria evidence is shown as not evaluated and existing AcceptancePassed/AcceptanceMessage values remain available.
Focused Korean/English contracts, Debug/Release builds, and fresh desktop smoke evidence pass; full theme/DPI/native hardware matrices remain explicitly reported as unverified.

context.location: OpenVisionNativePreviewExecutionController -> OpenVisionNativeToolDocument status; OpenVisionPipelineReviewResultPresenter -> GuideResultProjectionOwner; VisionPipelineRunReportStorage -> OpenVisionRecipeRunEvidenceDrawing
NativeToolDocument owns LastStatusText; Pipeline Review presenter owns aggregate result text; Run Report storage owns AcceptanceEvaluated persistence state.
Native Preview controller -> ToolDocument ApplyPreviewExecutionResult -> status presenter; Pipeline Review GuideResultProjectionOwner -> ResultPresenter; RunReportStorage -> RecipeRunEvidenceDrawing

evidence.observation: The native controller currently emits Preview/Offset OK or Preview NG strings without an acceptance-state marker. Pipeline Review FormatResultSummary currently renders only the aggregate status and elapsed/error text. VisionPipelineStepRunReport stores AcceptancePassed and AcceptanceMessage but no flag indicating whether UseAcceptance was enabled, and the evidence drawing renders a PASS/NG or missing-message label without a not-evaluated state.

Both Debug and Release Pipeline Review guide/result projection contracts exited 0 and report PASS. The contract covers missing-result, no-criteria OK, acceptance PASS, tool-NG, acceptance-NG, persisted evidence, Korean/English text, validation-error, running state, paired action/metric, and run-log projection preservation.

The Debug embedded desktop Preview validity scenario passed. Direct Preview success and failure statuses contain the inspection-not-evaluated marker; failed Preview invalidates only the current result while retaining the previous output; the valid retry restores the current result; input change invalidates it again. The report records DISPLAY2 bounds 0,0,1920,1080 and both shell/tool window rectangles intersecting that monitor, plus the exact executable and managed assembly hashes.

The final Debug PipelineViewer acceptance-NG WPF target exited OK (check=OK, layout=0, text=0, internal=0, 1600x900). Visual inspection confirms the compact processing/inspection distinction wraps in the top result card without clipping while the output preview and surrounding layout remain visible.
Final focused Debug and Release builds completed with exit 0, reporting 0 warnings and 0 errors for the embedded OpenVisionLab executable and VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke contract runner.

events.summary: Resolved after the existing Preview, Pipeline Review, Run Report, and recipe-evidence owners were updated and the focused contracts/build/UI evidence passed. The final native Preview rerun was not used as pass evidence because it timed out without a report; full theme/DPI/native hardware coverage remains outside this slice.
